notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43403780/7c16153684720de98390db9f66ec86462754139a.png[/img]

[b]Good news for all Chess Morphers[/b]

The new version of the game is live!

In this update, we are introducing the following features:
[list]
[*] Added support for Undo. If you made a wrong move, now you can undo it.
[*] Added localization support for 8 languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, German, 
Korean, Japanese)
[*] Added settings options for enabling/disabling sound effects and music individually.
[/list]
